notes: East-side Lutheran congregation ('Bringing the Word of God to the Eastside of Tucson'). A search snippet referred to a 'Pastor Parsons' with no first name, so no pastor is recorded. NOTE: at least three different Tucson churches are called Holy Cross - Lutheran (holycrosstucson.org, 241 N Harrison Rd), Presbyterian/PCA (holycrosstucson.com, 7250 N Cortaro Rd) and Anglican (3264 N Country Club Rd). The .org and .com domains are DIFFERENT churches; do not mix their sermon archives.
